==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*konьčiti}}. {{surf|ru|коне́ц|-ить}}. Cognates include {{cog|be|ко́нчыць}}, {{cog|uk|кінчи́ти}}, {{cog|pl|kończyć}}, {{cog|cs|končit}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|ко́нчить}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-кончить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|ко́нчить|pf|impf=конча́ть}}

# to [[finish]], to [[end]]
# to [[graduate]] from
# {{lb|ru|slang}} to [[ejaculate]], to [[cum]] ''(of a man)''; to [[orgasm]] ''(of a woman)''
# {{lb|ru|slang}} to [[kill]]; to [[waste]]
# to [[finish]]; to [[deplete]]

====Usage notes====
* While кончить is still theoretically a perfectly functional word, Russians are much more likely to use the words "закончить" and "окончить" respectively for the first two meanings. In modern speech, кончить is primarily associated with the third meaning.

==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|смотрѣ́ть||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|orv:съмотрѣти<ety:inh<sla-pro:*sъmotrěti<ety:af<*sъmotriti><*-ěti>>>>|tree=+}} {{inh+|ru|orv|съмотрѣти}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*sъmotrěti}}, which see {{cog|sla-pro|*sъmotriti}}. Compare {{m|sla-pro|*motriti||to look at, to watch}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|смотре́ть}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-смотреть.ogg}}
* {{IPA|ru|[smoˈtrʲetʲ]|~|[smɔ-]|a=rustic,Northern Russia}}
* {{IPA|ru|[smaˈtrʲetʲ]|a=Southern Russia}}
* {{IPA|ru|[smaˈtrɛt͡sʲ]|a=Belarus}} (''phonetic respelling'': смотрэ́ць)
* {{IPA|ru|[smɐˈtrʲɛtʲ]|a=Ukraine}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|смотре́ть|impf|pf=посмотре́ть|vn=смотре́ние}}

# to [[look]], to [[gaze]]
# to [[see]], to [[watch]]
# to [[view]], to [[review]]
# to [[examine]], to [[inspect]]
# to [[mind]]

====Usage notes====
* In contrast with {{m|ru|ви́деть}}, смотреть is used for when you are actively watching something, usually a performance or film. When you immediately see something, like a friend on the sidewalk, видеть is used.
* The form ''[[смотря]]'' has been largely grammaticalized and is rarely used as an adverbial participle. The syncretic form ''[[глядя]]'' is generally used instead.

==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|глядѣ́ть||ru-PRO}}
* {{l|ru|гля}} (clipping, interjection)

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*ględěti}}; compare {{m|sla-pro|*glę̀dati}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|гляде́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-глядеть.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|гляде́ть|impf|pf=взгляну́ть<q:semelfactive>,гля́нуть<q:semelfactive>,погляде́ть|vn=гляде́ние<q:nomen actionis>,гляде́лки<q:nomen actionis instantiae>}}

# to [[look]]
#: {{syn|ru|смотре́ть|глазе́ть|пя́литься|зы́рить}}
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1904|author=w:ru:Леонид Андреев|title=w:ru:Красный смех|chapter=[[s:ru:Красный_смех_(Андреев)/Отрывок_пятый|Отрывок пятый]]|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=Alexandra Linden|title2=The Red Laugh|location2=London|publisher2=T. Fisher|year2=1905|page2=|pageurl2=
|text=Студент '''глядел''' на молчаливое, разраставшееся зарево, и его затылок с вьющимися волосами был молодой, и когда я '''глядел''' на него, мне почему-то все представлялась тонкая женская рука, которая ворошит эти волосы.|t=The student stood '''gazing out''' at the mute spreading glow, and the back of his head with its curly hair was youthful; and when I '''looked''' at him, I do not know why, but I kept picturing to myself a delicate woman's hand passing through that hair.}}
# to [[look after]], to [[take care of]]
